SELECT (CAST(SUM("sales_sale"."total_amount") AS NUMERIC)) AS "total", (CAST(SUM("sales_sale"."discount_amount") AS NUMERIC)) AS "discount" FROM "sales_sale" WHERE django_datetime_cast_date("sales_sale"."confirmed_at", 'America/Lima', 'UTC') = '2026-11-13'

SELECT "catalog_product"."id", "catalog_product"."category_id", "catalog_product"."name", "catalog_product"."search_name", "catalog_product"."barcode", "catalog_product"."barcode_type", "catalog_product"."barcode_normalized", "catalog_product"."unit", "catalog_product"."sale_price", "catalog_product"."minimum_stock", "catalog_product"."controls_expiration", "catalog_product"."average_cost", "catalog_product"."is_active", "catalog_product"."created_at", "catalog_product"."updated_at" FROM "catalog_product" INNER JOIN "catalog_category" ON ("catalog_product"."category_id" = "catalog_category"."id") WHERE ("catalog_category"."is_active" AND "catalog_product"."is_active") ORDER BY "catalog_product"."name" ASC, "catalog_product"."barcode_normalized" ASC
